items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-153
items.summary: This update addresses critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities that could result in arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to this update.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers remote code execution, with attacks starting September 4th. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 7th for this vulnerability, rated CVSS 10.0.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe also recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: Critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution and privilege escalation in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Indications of exploitation in the wild have emerged.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability
items.summary: This is an RCE vulnerability in Adobe Commerce caused by improper encoding, enabling arbitrary code execution without user interaction or authentication. Successful exploitation can lead to full storefront compromise and payment data theft.
